name: Arx Libertatis
summary:
Arx Libertatis is an improved, cross-platform and open source engine for Arx Fatalis, a 2002 first-person role-playing game / dungeon crawler / immersive sim developed by Arkane Studios.

Arx Libertatis 1.2.1 updates and improves Arx Fatalis by supporting modern systems, porting the game to new platforms, as well as eliminating bugs and limitations.
